reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering an artifact, prepared foods, fish, forage, minerals, tree sap, and a combat ring were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established fish, recipe and glossary names, biological behavior, artifact context, loanword preservation, object gender, combat effects, and descriptive tone; both found no remaining objective issue.

RustySpur_Description.source: An old spur that was once attached to a cowboy's boot. People must have been raising animals in this area for many generations.
RustySpur_Description.translation: Un pinten vechi care a fost cândva prins de cizma unui cowboy. Oamenii trebuie să fi crescut animale în această zonă timp de multe generații.

Salad_Description.translation: O salată sănătoasă din legume de grădină.

Salmon_Description.source: Swims upstream to lay its eggs.
Salmon_Description.translation: Înoată în amonte pentru a-și depune icrele.

Salmonberry_Description.source: A spring-time berry with the flavor of the forest.
Salmonberry_Description.translation: O boabă de primăvară cu aroma pădurii.

SalmonDinner_Description.source: The lemon spritz makes it special.
SalmonDinner_Description.translation: Stropul de lămâie îi dă un gust deosebit.

Sandfish_Description.source: It tries to hide using camouflage.
Sandfish_Description.translation: Încearcă să se ascundă prin camuflaj.

Sandstone_Description.source: A common type of stone with red and brown striations.
Sandstone_Description.translation: Un tip comun de piatră, cu striații roșii și maro.

Sashimi_Name.preservationReason: Sashimi is the established Japanese dish name and is used unchanged in Romanian.

Sashimi_Description.source: Raw fish sliced into thin pieces.
Sashimi_Description.translation: Pește crud tăiat în felii subțiri.

SavageRing_Description.source: Gain a short speed boost whenever you slay a monster.
SavageRing_Description.translation: Primești un scurt impuls de viteză ori de câte ori ucizi un monstru.

ScorpionCarp_Description.source: It's like a regular carp but with a sharp stinger.
ScorpionCarp_Description.translation: Este ca un crap obișnuit, dar are un ac ascuțit.
